Data extraction: HCL attribute key-value pair

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"region = "us-east-1"
count  = 3
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"data_extraction":true,"language":"hcl"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let _ = process(source, &config);
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
    println!("{:?}", result.data.as_ref().unwrap().kind);
    println!("{:?}", result.data.as_ref().unwrap().children);
}
```
